Browser text rendering additionally bundles unmodified Noto Emoji from Google Fonts, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The font, license and pinned source commit are in fonts/. It supplies monochrome fallback glyphs for the existing authored emoji; native system-font rendering is unchanged. This is a declared presentation difference from a platform's color-emoji font.

The Replay levels/level_1.tres and level_2.tres carry the original level stocks and wave plans, with the script changed to ReplayCaveLevelDef, stale UID fields removed, and an explicit rectangular rift proxy added. The source definition hashes are:

  • examples/cavecrawl/levels/level_1.tres: ca2b83f039a2be63ba64ea6eba2b64b77df27d94b9034d98c9cc40436530f7cc.
  • examples/cavecrawl/levels/level_2.tres: 0c56803ac455d65d70459bb8d79de185fc13a4451fb314026ef857c2626f7032.

Seeded scatter ports the integer recipe from examples/cavecrawl/scripts/world.odin; the regression oracle extracts that original procedure and compares all generated coordinates with Replay on native and WASM. See authoring.md.
